# lias-freight-bq4t

Live at https://lias-freight-bq4t.folkapps.com. Vite + React + Tailwind, compiled and deployed as a static bundle by folk after your session exits. The global rules in `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` apply here too.

Only a `create_or_edit_app` run publishes. Editing, building or committing these files from a terminal never changes the live site.

## Data

No database. Persist with `localStorage` (JSON.parse/stringify for complex objects). Forms use `mailto:`, an external form service, or a confirmation state — there is no backend.

## Design contract

**Tokens.** Navy #0E2A47 (primary surfaces, headings, primary buttons), navy-deep #081B2F (footer), navy-soft #1B3D5E (lines on navy), signal amber #F2A516 (the one accent: active states, route line, focus ring, eyebrows on navy), paper #F5F4F0 (canvas), ink #101A2B (body), muted #5B6676, hairline #E2E0D8. WhatsApp green #1A9E4F is reserved for WhatsApp actions. Display: Barlow Condensed (500/600/700) via @fontsource/barlow-condensed. Body: IBM Plex Sans (400/500/600) via @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans. Utility and eyebrows: IBM Plex Mono 500 via @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono. Layout: max-w-6xl column, floating header with a centered pill nav, rounded-2xl white cards with shadow-lift. Signature element: the navy RouteGraphic SVG (amber route from port to door, containers) in the home hero. Photography: real port photos (Unsplash URLs) are used as the home hero background, with a navy gradient scrim (the only gradient, for text legibility), a home gallery strip under the services row, an About banner, a Services banner plus a cropped image beside each service, and a Contact banner. Photos are <img> with alt text, loading="lazy", object-fit cover, and rounded-2xl/3xl corners. On the home hero, text is white and the primary CTA is signal amber, since navy disappears on the photo. Brand mark (components/Logo.jsx): a navy rounded tile with an amber globe, meridian and anchor, used in the header and footer beside "Lias Freight Global Services". Home has an "Our clients" band after the services row, linking to /clients, which lists placeholder client cards with grey "Logo placeholder" boxes.

**Simplicity.** Up front: the four services, the primary phone, one contact CTA. On demand: service detail on /services, and the form's confirmation step. Tray (components/Tray.jsx): the contact form's "Send this message?" confirmation. It rises from the bottom on mobile and is a centered dialog above sm, holds one Send action, and closes via X, Escape, backdrop, or a downward drag. Focus returns to the submit button on close.

**Fluidity.** Shared spring: { type: "spring", stiffness: 260, damping: 30, mass: 0.9 }, exported as spring from components/Reveal.jsx. layoutId="nav-pill" in Header travels the active pill between nav items. Page changes slide horizontally via PageTransition inside AnimatePresence mode="wait", so forward navigation moves left and back moves right. No label morphs yet. Reduced motion: springs fall back to short fades via useReducedMotion.

**Delight.** Tier 1: the header menu icon rotates on open, the WhatsApp button springs in and presses to 0.92, the Open now / Closed now pill follows Lagos working hours live, and form errors fade in. Tier 2: staggered Reveal entrances, the route line draws on the hero, and the tray spring. Tier 3 (one moment): the thank-you state after a sent message, with a spring-in check badge. The surprise is not yet implemented.
